Tiny Trails: Space

Trace a twinkly trail from planet to planet.

See what's free

No ads · No tracking · No accounts

A calm tracing game. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.

Coming soon. Ages 3–6 · Free to start · $0.99 one-time unlock

Coming soon to phones and tablets.

How it plays

  • Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
  • Visit little planets, each with its own look. Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds are open from the start.
  • Pick a little explorer to guide along the trail. More explorers come with the one-time unlock.
  • No timers and nothing to read. Play again whenever you like.

What's free

Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds.

What the $0.99 unlock adds

All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription.

One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.

There is nothing to buy on this website.
